product_one_liner.value: Sona provides AI-driven workforce management—including scheduling, time and attendance, HR, and payroll—for large frontline operators.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page exists and describes configurable pricing.

named_customers.notes: Sona’s About page says it helps these frontline organisations.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 255 employees, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies London, England, UK as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Sona states that it was founded in 2021.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index presents workforce-management/editorial, customer, and news content; the evidence did not show at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public Support Help Centre has several product categories and multiple support articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists a Senior Machine Learning Engineer opening.

model_provider.notes: The sub-processor list labels both as LLM providers.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names ISO 27001:2022 and GDPR; only the requested listed items are included.

last_funding.notes: Sona announced a $45 million Series B on April 1, 2026; this is the latest round found.

raised_18mo.notes: The $45 million Series B was announced in April 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page lists Business Development Representative and Account Executive roles.

launched_6mo.notes: Sona announced its LMS launch on June 22, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Jennifer Johnson’s profile lists her as VP, Solution Marketing at Sona starting September 1, 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Both are named as CRM tools/providers on Sona’s sub-processor list.
